headlines.text: 10-year Treasury yield climbs toward 5%, its highest since 2023, as a global bond selloff accelerates ahead of today's CPI report.
Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq head for a fourth straight losing day and a weekly decline as traders brace for the last big inflation read before the Fed meets.
Oil tops $105 a barrel after Houthi rebels seize a key Red Sea port, tightening the squeeze on global shipping chokepoints.
Traders lift odds of a Fed rate hike next week to 71% after a hotter-than-expected PPI print, even as Friday's CPI looms as the tiebreaker.
Trump administration escalates pressure on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to cut rates just days before the September 16 FOMC decision.
Fed Chair Warsh and colleagues have likely already made up their minds on a hike heading into the Sept. 16 meeting, regardless of today's CPI.
Kroger reports fiscal Q2 earnings before the bell, an early test for new CEO Greg Foran's turnaround push against Walmart and Costco.
